claim: *Three distinct relations.* Correspondence tests agreement between representations; conformance tests an artifact against an independent obligation; acceptance asks whether the receiving environment will take the result. Evidence for one relation does not establish the others.

topology.description: Three unordered comparison bands; symmetric correspondence vs directed conformance and acceptance.

required_terms: Evidence for one relation does not establish the others.
bw_encoding: Grayscale publication candidate. Gray distinguishes representation, independent obligation and receiving environment; bidirectional correspondence and directed conformance/acceptance retained.
redesign: Gray distinguishes representation, independent obligation and receiving environment; bidirectional correspondence and directed conformance/acceptance retained.
alt: Three stacked bands distinguish correspondence, conformance and acceptance. Correspondence links two internal representations in both directions. Conformance asks whether an artifact satisfies an independent obligation. Acceptance asks whether a receiving environment will take it. The three provide different evidence. Gray fills distinguish the source semantic roles; labels and line conventions retain their meanings.
